changes: Enabled WebGL2 alpha-to-coverage for foliage and grass cutouts to reduce billboard edge aliasing.
Reduced grass/shrub overdraw and softened per-instance value jitter to remove repeated hard bands while retaining layered forest edges.
Lowered golden-hour key and sun-disc energy to preserve road and vegetation detail.
Raised moonlit hemisphere and ambient fill, with a night-only multiplier, so terrain and foliage remain readable without lifting the night sky.
notes: Golden frame retains a warm readable road and layered verge; night frame now shows road, vehicle, tree silhouettes and grass detail rather than a crushed black field.
